text:
Mia: Quick sync — NovaEdge reserved pool goes live next Tue 09:00 PT. Need to lock quota, autoscale policy, and smoke/soak window. Who's on for what?
Sam: I can own autoscale policy + alerts. thinking 20% headroom for first 48h to avoid early throttles :thinking_face:
Raja: Infra has 8 A100 slots reserved, 2 kept as infra buffer. Need confirmation on cache priming plan (KV/prefix reuse).
Lina: QA can run smoke + soak. Proposal: smoke = 5k reqs over 30m then soak = 50k over 2h. Will validate tail latency and token cost.
Kevin: I’ll assemble the customer runbook and on-call rotation. Do we have a lighter model variant for graceful degradation?
Mia: Yes — fallback alias is novaedge-v1-lite (quantized). Also need KMS ACLs for log ingestion and audit. @Anita can you confirm?
Anita: KMS ACLs: I granted novaedge-prod ingestion role to the service principal. Send the principal IDs if anything else. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Autoscale draft snippet (will push to infra config):
```
autoscale_policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  target_utilization: 0.6
  cooldown: 120s
  scale_step: 2
```
Raja: That looks good. We'll reserve 2 extra ephemeral GPUs for sudden spikes; those are not in quota but reserved by infra. Need the expected RPS profile from QA.
Lina: RPS profile attached here (short). For smoke: steady ~80 RPS, bursts to 200 for 30s. For soak: average 400 RPS with peak 800. Will post raw k6 results to the thread.
Kevin: Load command we'll run for smoke: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m smoke.js` — I'll coordinate the run window (prefer 03:00-04:00 PT to reduce customer impact).
Mia: Canary rollout plan: 10% traffic 1h, 50% 4h, 100% after acceptance. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 1.5s or error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. Agree?
Sam: Agreed. I'll wire alerts to PagerDuty and Slack channel. Will also add an autoscale safeguard that prevents scale-down within first 30m after scale-up.
Raja: Add infra healthchecks: GPU memory pressure, KV cache hit rate, and pod restart count. If restart_count > 1 in 10m, auto rollback to previous model.
deploy-bot: reserved-pool assigned: tenant=novaedge-prod, slots=8/8, runbook=https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/novaedge-reserved, deployment_id=rsv-1749998888
Lina: One question — do we allow requests that require long sequences (>2k tokens) in the smoke? That skews cost.
Mia: For smoke, cap seq_len to 1024. We'll run a separate long-seq profile for tuning quantization.
Kevin: I'll create the support cadence doc and include escalation matrix. Also scheduling: customer enablement call Wed 11:00 PT.
Anita: Security note — enable VPC egress restrictions for the canary window and log retention at 90d for audit trail.
Mia: Action items: Mia = schedule enablement + confirm customer readiness; Sam = finalize autoscale + alerts; Raja = infra buffer + healthchecks; Lina = run smoke/soak and upload results; Kevin = runbook + rotation; Anita = finalize KMS & VPC ACLs.
Sam: I'll post the final autoscale yaml by EOD.
Lina: Will kick off smoke tomorrow 03:00 PT, posting artifacts here.
Mia: Perfect. Everyone, please react with :thumbsup: when done with your item so I can mark it closed.
Kevin: +1 :thumbsup:
Raja: :thumbsup:
Anita: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Lina: :thumbsup:
Mia: Thanks all — tagging this for the ops checklist before go-live.
